specialty_focus: Grifols is a global healthcare company that produces life-saving, plasma-derived medicines, diagnostic systems, and biological supplies for hospitals and research. It collects human plasma through a massive international network of donation centers to manufacture protein therapies that treat rare, chronic, and serious medical conditions. Grifols.com Core Product Categories Immunoglobulins (IVIG/SCIG): Proteins like Gamunex and Xembify used to treat immune deficiencies and autoimmune disorders.
